name: toggle-cip
description: Toggle used to enable/disable Commercial Inspection Program functionality in application.  Values should be set to true or false.

name: toggle-tif
description: Toggle used to enable/disable Traffic Impact Fee functionality in application.  Values should be set to true or false.

name: toggle-sewer-connection-charges
description: Toggle used to enable/disable Connection Charge Worksheet functionality in application.  Values should be set to true or false.

name: toggle-srs
description: used to toggle Code Enforcement functionality in application; values should be set to true or false

name: toggle-legacy
description: Used to toggle legacy functionality (hard coding) in the application; values should be set to true or false.
